d: During a media briefing, Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal responded to questions on a range of external and internal developments. He stated that Regional Passport Office Chennai issued a show-cause notice to Saurabh Das on November 23, 2026, based on inputs from law enforcement authorities seeking clarification within seven days regarding his place of birth, while advising against using the passport pending a response.
